      having given away a thing!’ And the Brahmana then obtained from the king a
      thousand kine and went away.”

transliteration: tais tair vihārair bahubhir daityānāṃ kāmarūpiṇām / samāḥ saṃkrīḍatāṃ teṣām ahar ekam ivābhavat
